parentId.sh: The ID of the parent folder to nest this folder under

folderId.sh: ID of the folder to place the form in.

questions.sh: List of form questions with their fields

status.sh: Deleting a form is done through DELETE /forms/{formId}, which moves it to the trash so it can be restored.

templateId.sh: ID of the template to base the form on

workspaceId.sh: ID of the workspace to create the form in.

title.sh: The new title for the question

externalSubscriber.sh: Optional identifier for the external subscriber

formId.sh: The ID of the form to create the webhook for

httpHeaders.sh: Optional custom HTTP headers to include in webhook requests

lastSyncedAt.sh: When the webhook was last synced

signingSecret.sh: Optional secret used to sign webhook payloads

updatedAt.sh: When the webhook was last updated

url.sh: The URL to send webhook events to

test.description: In-memory mock transport for testing without a live server
test.name: test
test.title: Test transport
